title: Best CTV Advertising Platforms Every Advertiser Should Know in 2026 | Strategus

facts.fact: Strategus's vendor case study reports that a supplement retailer drove over $3 million in revenue from a 3-month CTV campaign across all attribution tracking.
facts.quote: Learn how a supplement retailer drove over $3 million in revenue from a 3-month CTV campaign across all attribution tracking.

facts.fact: The page lists five types of CTV advertising platforms: SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, DMPs, and publisher platforms and walled gardens.
facts.quote: CTV buying typically involves multiple platforms that work in tandem, depending on your advertising goals. These include:

facts.fact: The page lists five targeting attributes that CTV platforms can use: personal interests, browsing activities, household income, education level, and viewing habits.
facts.quote: You can reach viewers based on: Personal interests Browsing activities Household income Education level Viewing habits

facts.fact: In the programmatic CTV process described, the highest bid wins the ad slot and the ad plays for the viewer.
facts.quote: The highest bid wins, and the ad plays for the viewer.

facts.fact: The guide is titled as a best-platforms guide for 2026.
facts.quote: Best CTV Advertising Platforms Every Advertiser Should Know in 2026 | Strategus

facts.fact: According to AdExchanger, as cited by Strategus, 75% of CTV ads are now placed programmatically.
facts.quote: 75% of CTV ads are now placed programmatically

facts.fact: Strategus states that Magnite's supply coverage reportedly reaches 99% of CTV inventory globally (a reported figure, not independently verified on the page).
facts.quote: Its supply coverage reportedly reaches 99 % of CTV inventory globally.

facts.fact: Strategus states that Amazon DSP's recent partnership with Roku extends reach to approximately 80 million U.S. CTV households.
facts.quote: Its recent partnership with Roku extends reach to ~80M U.S. CTV households for high-performance ad campaigns.

facts.fact: Strategus reports that Microsoft is sunsetting its Invest DSP by 2026, while the Microsoft Monetize SSP remains operational.
facts.quote: Despite Microsoft’s sunset of its Invest DSP by 2026, the SSP arm remains operational

facts.fact: Strategus states that the DSP side of Microsoft Invest is being sunset by early 2026, with inventory remaining available via Xandr as an exchange.
facts.quote: though its DSP side is being sunset by early 2026

facts.fact: Strategus states that open ad exchanges are open to any advertiser, while private marketplaces (PMPs) are invite-only and offer better-quality inventory.
facts.quote: Open ad exchanges – Open to any advertiser. Private marketplaces (PMPs) – Invite-only and offer better-quality inventory.

facts.fact: Strategus states that advertisers wanting to join PMPs must build relationships with publishers or work with a CTV partner such as Strategus.
facts.quote: to join PMPs, advertisers need to build relationships with publishers or work with a CTV partner like Strategus

facts.fact: Strategus states that Index Exchange's ad podding is based on OpenRTB 2.6.
facts.quote: Its OpenRTB 2.6-based ad podding, deal tools, and strict quality standards

facts.fact: Resonate's CTV Insights solution enriches CTV device IDs with 14,000+ attributes across over 230 million U.S. consumers, according to the page's description of Resonate.
facts.quote: its "CTV Insights" solution enriches CTV device IDs with 14,000+ attributes across over 230 million U.S. consumers

facts.fact: Nielsen's Nielsen ONE suite combines big data from 45 million households with panel-based insights, according to the page.
facts.quote: It combines big data from 45 million households with panel-based insights

facts.fact: SambaTV uses panel and Automatic Content Recognition across approximately 46 million smart TVs to capture ad exposure and viewing behavior, according to the page.
facts.quote: uses panel and Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) across ~46 million smart TVs

facts.fact: Strategus states that its premium inventory includes access to over 200 publishers.
facts.quote: Our [premium inventory](https://www.strategus.com/premium-inventory) includes access to over 200 publishers to ensure precise ad placement.

facts.fact: The page cites Cordcutters News to say almost 90% of homes have an internet-connected TV (third-party figure, undated on the page).
facts.quote: Today, almost [90% of homes have an internet-connected TV](https://cordcuttersnews.com/almost-90-of-u-s-households-use-internet-connected-tvs-to-stream/)

facts.fact: The page states that laptops and mobile devices fall under OTT devices and offer less premium inventory than big-screen televisions, so CTV devices refer only to equipment supporting big-screen viewing.
facts.quote: Because laptops and mobile devices are used for small-screen streaming, they fall in the category of OTT devices and offer less premium inventory

facts.fact: The page defines CTV devices as any equipment used to stream video content on television sets, including smart TVs, streaming media players, gaming consoles, and set-top boxes.
facts.quote: Any equipment used to stream video content on television sets can be classified as a CTV device.

facts.fact: The page says ad-supported HVOD services such as Netflix, Prime, and Disney+ generate revenue through a mix of commercials and subscription plans.
facts.quote: Ad-supported subscriptions to services like Netflix, Prime, and Disney+ fall into the HVOD category because they generate revenue through a mix of commercials and subscription plans.

facts.fact: The page says vMVPD services such as YouTube TV deliver linear TV channels with ads to paying subscribers.
facts.quote: vMVPD services like YouTube TV deliver linear TV channels (with ads) to paying subscribers.

facts.fact: The page says set-top boxes receive and decode video signals from cable and satellite services and are typically offered by those providers.
facts.quote: Set-top boxes are devices that receive and decode video signals from cable and satellite services

facts.fact: The page lists six popular streaming media players for 2026, including Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K, Apple TV 5K, and Roku Streaming Stick+.
